title: Find the cleanest feasible execution slot
description: Choose a workload, its latest allowed start, and its approved placement boundary. The board recomputes compute and transfer emissions for every illustrative forecast slot.
boundaryNote: All grid intensities are invented scenario inputs for learning, not live regional measurements. Replace them with time-stamped, source-labeled forecasts before making an operational claim.
